verdict.rationale: Core RAG capability is well-documented (chat with your own docs, private knowledge base, RAG built-in) and corroborated by hands-on community use, including a user testing citations on regulatory PDFs. However, that same hands-on report notes citation quality was 'dicey' with some garbled content, indicating grounding isn't always precise. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of retrieval accuracy across document types, and resolution of the noted citation-quality issue.
